tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind header, controls and table frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Table body cells, sticky provider column, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sticky table header, open row-detail row, hovered row, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline cell borders and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles and the detail button (3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, cell values, headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, per-year averages, Datenstand, footnotes, legend descriptions on all three surfaces (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active sort arrow, focus ring, selected toggle. Text on surface and surface-raised (≥6:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the cheapest value per column. Always paired with bold num-strong text in ink, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent control (selected segment of the brutto/netto toggle).

tokens.name: promo-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Aktionspreis badge.

tokens.name: promo-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Aktionspreis badge on promo-bg.

tokens.name: operator-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'Angebot des Portalbetreibers' badge. Neutral, never brighter than the other badges.

tokens.name: operator-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the operator badge on operator-bg.

tokens.name: verified-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Anbieter-bestätigt badge.

tokens.name: verified-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Anbieter-bestätigt badge on verified-bg.

tokens.name: stale-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text for expired promos and old Datenstand, on surface-raised and surface-sunken. Always with words, never colour alone.

families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h2 on text pages and in the row detail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Maßgeblich ist immer das Angebot auf der Seite des Anbieters.
styles.usage: Running text on Methodik, Impressum, Datenschutz.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Text cells in the price table, controls, row detail.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Units, footnotes, legend text, status line.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The site name in the header. Always lowercase.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every price, sum, day and month count. Right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: num-strong
styles.usage: The cheapest value of a column, on accent-soft.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API paths, file paths, TLDs in running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit or average.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical cell padding, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal cell padding, gap inside a control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between controls, row-detail grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between header, controls and table.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between sections on text pages and before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, toggles, detail button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Table frame, column-picker panel.
